_comment: The English catalogue. Every string is transcribed from the approved click dummy, which owns the words as well as the layout, EXCEPT the pending.* block - that declares an unbuilt screen and is new app-side copy - and the run.excluded* block, which names an engine fact (summary.excluded[]) the dummy has no equivalent for. GATE 4 was granted on 2026-09-05 and the 38 approved changes are in the dummy; the ones that touch a screen this app has built are reflected here. A change is written into the dummy first and copied here second, never the other way round.

theme.title: Appearance
consent.title: windowsweep collects usage data to improve the product for everyone.
consent.lede: The cleanup engine makes <1>zero network calls</1> – its own test suite asserts that, and that does not change. What follows is only about the desktop window you are looking at.
consent.provider.ga4.name: Product analytics
consent.provider.ga4.what: Which screens you opened and which buttons you pressed.
consent.provider.amplitude.name: Behaviour analytics
consent.provider.amplitude.what: The same events, in a second analytics tool.
consent.provider.clarity.name: Session replay
consent.provider.clarity.what: A recording of this window with every piece of text masked.
consent.provider.sentry.name: Crash reports
consent.provider.sentry.what: A stack trace when something breaks, with file paths stripped out.
consent.detailsSummary: What the window sends, in plain terms
consent.neverSent: a file path, a folder name, a drive label, your user name, your machine name, or the contents of anything. A run summary is a count and a number of bytes.
consent.noSwitch: There is no switch for this and no setting to find. This is how windowsweep gets better for the next person who runs it.
pending.body: This tab is not built yet. It is named here rather than hidden, so what is missing is a stated gap rather than something you have to discover.
common.loading: Reading the catalogue from the engine
error.engineMissing: The cleanup engine did not start. Reinstall windowsweep, or run the command-line tool once to confirm it works.
splash.step.updateNoAnswer: Checking for a newer build… no answer
splash.detailsSummary: What happens while this is on screen
splash.detailsWhat: Three things, none of which touch your disk: the bundled engine reports its version, the catalogue is read from <1>--list --json</1> so a new section appears without an app update, and the updater checks whether a newer build exists.
splash.detailsNothing: Nothing is scanned and nothing is deleted until you ask. If the update check cannot reach the network it is skipped and says so - reclaiming space has never needed it.
splash.update.body: Install it now, or carry on and install it later. Your settings and history are untouched either way.
splash.update.offlineTitle: The update check could not reach the network.
splash.update.offlineBody: Skipped - nothing else in windowsweep needs it.
splash.update.retriedOffline: Checked again - still offline. Carrying on without it.
